home.title: One sheet.
home.intro: Discover how a single sheet takes shape. Follow each fold in 3D, turn the paper in your hands, and trace it back to the beginning.
home.alt: A sage paper crane with long pointed wings and a folded beak.

guide.title: Crease notation
guide.intro: Read a fold from the side of the paper facing you. The crease line tells you which way the paper bends.
guide.valleyText: A dashed line marks a valley. Bring the two sides toward you so the crease sits at the bottom of a V.
guide.mountainText: A dash-dot line marks a mountain. Fold the sides away from you so the crease rises into a ridge.

paper-airplane.title: Dart paper airplane
paper-airplane.summary: Turn a portrait rectangle into a pointed dart with two swept wings and a narrow body.

paper-heart.title: Paper heart
paper-heart.summary: Fold a square into two broad lobes with a center notch and a pointed base.

fox-face.title: Fox face
fox-face.summary: Turn back two pointed ears and lift one loose tip to give a fox its two-tone muzzle.

masu-box.title: Masu box
masu-box.summary: Raise four walls from a square and wrap the end flaps over the corners to lock an open box.

player.gestures: Drag to orbit. Pinch or scroll to zoom. Focus the paper and use the arrow keys to turn it.
player.instant: Next and Previous move one fold at a time. The middle button switches between the finished model and the starting sheet.
player.orbit: Drag or use arrow keys to orbit
player.openInfo: Open Info for the folding instructions.
